verdict.rationale: Evidence mentions 'drop into voice huddles' as a feature (buzz-gh-2), suggesting audio/video calling exists within the app, but there is no documentation on how to initiate a call from a channel/DM, no UI walkthrough, and no independent confirmation it works as described.
